title: An owner raises the monthly AWS spend ceiling from the workspace
description:
## Found while sequencing `chatticus-1d68fb`

`PATCH /orgs/{tenant}/monthly-aws-spend-ceiling` exists (`http/app.py`) and Gherkin for `chatticus-43e64c` raises the ceiling via the **kernel**, not that route. There is no workspace control. Self-setup collects the ceiling once (`SelfSetupCrossAccountRolePanel`).

If crossing the ceiling converts an unbounded bill into **contact an operator**, that is a person-step in the invitation-rate math and the brake is not self-serve.

## Gherkin (draft)

```
Feature: Owner raises the monthly AWS spend ceiling
  As an organization owner
  I want to raise the monthly AWS spend ceiling from the workspace
  So that paused computer work can resume without an operator

  Scenario: An owner raises the ceiling through the product
    Given an enabled organization whose computer work is paused at its spend ceiling
    When the owner submits a higher ceiling from the workspace
    Then PATCH /orgs/{tenant}/monthly-aws-spend-ceiling succeeds
    And computer work is accepted again

  Scenario: A non-owner is refused
    Given an enabled organization with a monthly spend ceiling
    When a member who is not an owner submits a ceiling change from the workspace
    Then the change is refused
    And the ceiling is unchanged
```

## Done when

An owner on development raises the ceiling through the product (not the members CLI / kernel). Behavior in Gherkin first. Confirm on the `chatticus-1d68fb` live pass what a member can do next.
